review_response_tasks.stem: Her job is reporting news on our school radio. She is a ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：reporter为报道新闻的人，符合题面职业定义。；B：dancer为舞者，不是报道新闻这一工作。；C：cook为厨师，不是所定义的工作。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our plan says: “Afternoon snack 15:30.” At 15:30, we have a ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：安排明确是afternoon snack，不是早餐。；B：安排不是晚餐。；C：符合本题明确给出的下午加餐安排。

review_response_tasks.stem: The sports-day rule says “Keep off the grass.” We must not ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：在小径上走不违反远离草地的规定。；B：直接违反明确给出的Keep off the grass。；C：坐在长椅上不是踏草地，不是此规则禁止动作。

review_response_tasks.stem: Mei needs a yellow hat, not a coat or a blue hat. She chooses the ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：颜色和物品类别都符合。；B：颜色对，但外套不是帽子。；C：类别对，颜色不符。

review_response_tasks.stem: Bag A is open; bag B is closed. A is ____, but B is ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：将两只包的状态反转了。；B：第二项与B closed冲突。；C：两项均直接符合题面给定状态。

review_response_tasks.stem: This ticket has the name of a film and my seat number. I use it at the ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：该票用于影片座位，不是图书馆借书。；B：影片和座位号共同指向影院。；C：该票不是邮局业务凭证。

review_response_tasks.stem: To measure a line in centimetres, I use the marks on a ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：尺上的刻度可量线长，符合定义。；B：胶棒用于黏合，不提供题面所述测量刻度功能。；C：橡皮用于擦除，不是有量厘米刻度的尺。

review_response_tasks.stem: I ____ a message to our teacher yesterday.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：yesterday明确过去时间，不用原形send。；B：没有助动词，不用sending单独作本句谓语。；C：sent为send的过去式，符合时间。

review_response_tasks.stem: At Badge Day, we give a badge and keep a different one, without paying. We ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：明确不付款，不是购买。；B：给出一枚并保留另一枚，符合交换。；C：没有绘画行为，不能以draw概括交换。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our toy robot has red hands and blue feet. Its hands are ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：直接符合作者玩具的已给手部颜色。；B：blue描述脚，不是手。；C：与已给red hands不符。
